summary: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. filed an 8-K reporting two routine items: (1) an unregistered sale of 236,512 Class I shares for $2,147,527 under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S, a continuation of its continuous offering; and (2) a declared monthly distribution of ~$0.0701/share payable August 31, 2026 to holders of record July 31, 2026. The filing also updates the status of the ongoing public offering (up to $14.0B) and the private offering. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or activist campaign is disclosed; this is standard periodic reporting for a BDC.
